classifications.rationale: The preliminary recommendation selected the official SDK without making its dependency cost, API break, new-stability risk, and deliberately narrow binding claim explicit.

material_corrections: State plainly that the current package is not A2A v1 despite its labels.
Pin @a2a-js/sdk@1.0.1 while acknowledging jose/uuid, breaking migration, and newly stable API risk.
Declare JSON-RPC only and prohibit implied REST, gRPC, push, signing, or multi-tenant claims.
Require auth and graph policy to run before mutation.
Treat the A2UI v0.9.1 versus legacy v0.8 extension mismatch as a governed boundary.
Pin the TCK commit and scope every report to executed normative scenarios.
